name: io.github.axveritasprotocol/axveritas
title: Axveritas
description: Pre-flight URL checks and clean page text for AI agents: skip dead pages before your LLM reads them.

tools.name: axveritas_preflight_check
tools.description: Pre-flight URL dead-end check (1 preflight credit or $0.005 USDC). Returns PASSABLE or DEAD_END with a category and reason: blocked (WAF/403/429), broken (4xx/5xx), timeout, js_shell (needs a browser), soft_block (CAPTCHA page served as 200), soft_404. Call before fetching any external URL.

force_live_probe.description: Skip the shared 6h cache and probe live

tools.name: axveritas_scrape_verified
tools.description: Schema-verified web extraction (1 scrape credit or $0.02 USDC). Returns clean JSON (url, title, description, headings, links, text) with an ABVS-1.0 SHA-256 receipt; fails if any required_keys are missing or empty.

required_keys.description: Keys that must be present and non-empty (default: title, text)

tools.name: axveritas_usage
tools.description: Free (no credits): show remaining credits and your savings so far — dead ends avoided and estimated tokens saved.

tools.name: axveritas_relay_create
tools.description: Hire another agent (a 'worker') safely: Axveritas calls the worker's endpoint, checks its JSON output has the required fields and at least the minimum number of records, and only then lets you have it. Fee: 1% of bounty_usdc ($0.005 minimum, 1 credit with an API key). Without worker_wallet the verified output is returned immediately. With worker_wallet (settlement mode) the output is held and you get a job_id, a secret release_token and payment instructions: send the stated USDC amount on Base (chain 8453) directly to the worker's wallet using your wallet tool, then call axveritas_relay_release with the transaction hash. Axveritas never holds funds. Keep the release_token; it is shown only once.

target_worker_endpoint.description: Worker agent's HTTPS endpoint. It receives POST {url, required_keys} and must return JSON.

target_scrape_url.description: The URL or task target the worker should process

bounty_usdc.description: Job value in USDC; the worker receives this minus the 1% fee

required_keys.description: Fields every record (or the top-level object) must contain

expected_min_records.description: Minimum number of records the output must contain

worker_wallet.description: Optional: worker's Base wallet (0x...) to enable verify -> pay -> release settlement

tools.name: axveritas_relay_release
tools.description: Settlement mode, final step: after paying the worker in USDC on Base, submit the job_id, release_token and the payment transaction hash. Axveritas checks on-chain that the right amount reached the worker's wallet in time, then returns the verified output (check it against payload_hash). Calling again with the same transaction returns the output again. Free.

payment_tx.description: 0x-prefixed Base transaction hash of your USDC payment to the worker

tools.name: axveritas_relay_status
tools.description: Free: check a relay job's status (AWAITING_PAYMENT, RELEASED or EXPIRED), payment instructions and deadline. Does not return the data.
